prompt: We're a small indie game studio and we're launching an online course on how we build our games, from pixel art pipelines to shipping on Steam. Build a sales page for it in index.html, aimed at people who already own our games and follow our devlogs, so it should feel like a thank-you to them, not a hard sell. Keep the vibe calm and trustworthy: clear pricing, what's in each module, a refund promise, no countdown timers or pushy stuff. Make it look world-class: run the design loop, and don't stop to ask me questions, pick sensible defaults.
